title: A failed live fixture deletes its nested launcher's run files, so a diagnosis has only the outer log
outcome: When a live test that runs a nested launcher fails, the nested run's results and log are still available for diagnosis, and passing tests still leave nothing behind.
acceptance: After a panic in a live fixture that ran a nested launcher, that launcher's results and focused log are available afterwards, either retained on disk or quoted in full in the failure output
A passing run leaves no extra files, and the test temp guard's accounting of leaked roots stays correct
